title: The eel-trader's bounty hint ('Worst of it's near the Eel-Run, if you know the place') never matched any room name I actually found. After exploring roughly two dozen distinct Fenmarch fen tiles looking for it, I finally stumbled on the creature by chance at 'Shingle's Edge,' reached from the Saltkerns side via 'Cutter's Path' — nothing anywhere was ever named 'the Eel-Run.'
